answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 24 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the grove stamp is verified against the cipher nonce, the walnut audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus burns the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 375 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
